summary: Add opt-in managed writer transaction budgets and scoped test accounting without activating heal repair.

replay.detail: No replay, heal, receive or repair route adopts this API. Existing full replay and its writer-hold gap remain unchanged. The following owner must explicitly qualify a complete repair/publication contract.

schema.detail: No persistent schema, trigger, index or schema-version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint retention, proof, ordering, rules digest or seal change.

compatibility.detail: Additive Rust API for explicitly owned busy/progress policies and a managed BEGIN/prepare/work/finalizer/COMMIT budget. Existing constructors retain their handlers and refuse budgeting as unknown. Raw hook setters require explicit ownership invalidation; this is an owner contract, not unsafe handler introspection. Test-support scopes count completed statement work on their thread, including guard-return callbacks, independently of transaction interruption.

downtime.detail: No extra startup gate. Normal deployment restarts still apply; restart-to-API/health and writer/read latency were not measured. Cooperative SQL interruption does not impose a hard fsync, rollback, Rust callback, queue wait or guard-return observer wall cap.

manual.detail: No operator action or new production configuration. Handler ownership and any later runtime adoption are explicit source changes.

recovery.detail: No new durable representation. Budget failure before COMMIT rolls back; a successful COMMIT is never reported as cancelled because later elapsed time or policy restoration failed. Failed restoration or unresolved rollback closes the writer to prevent reuse.
